schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2017: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. A 1(b)(i) and B 2(b)(i) are priced “1 mharc + 1 mharc” and expose one-mark slots; every other (a) part of Q1–5 (2 mharc + 1 mharc) and both 6(a) stay whole as 0/2/3, except B 4(a), one answer priced {3 mharc} with printed partials 2 and 1.

A 6(b) prices two independent six-mark reasons (reason 2 + discussion 4); each half is also a practice slot. B 6(b) is one response priced as the reaction 2 and two points 5 + 5 (as 2018 B 6(b)): three criteria of one part, no slots. Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff).

Prose: 2A (the Hurlamaboc extract) and 2B (an optional novel extract) are one card each; poetry 3A (Géibheann) and 3B (an optional modern poem) and the six Q4 options are one card each; the optional text itself is open content chosen inside one route. No 2017 prose option is a film or a play.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint A 50 and B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 (2A or 2B); Ceist 3 Filíocht 30 (3A or 3B); Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (one of 4A–4F).
Reading A “TG4 – Fiche Bliain ag Fás” (paper 4–5, scheme PDF 17–20); B “An Cogadh sa tSiria agus Géarchéim na nDídeanaithe” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 20–23).

Literature language: 5 marks for Gaeilge in every literature answer (scheme PDF 24); prose 25 Eolas; poetry printed (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 on the paper, assessed as Eolas 13, 5 (the reaction 1 + one point 4) and 7 (the poet’s name 1 + three points of life and work at 2 each) plus Gaeilge 5 once; Q4 Eolas 35; 4F printed (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10, assessed as Eolas 19 (theme 2 + contrast 17), 8 (the emotion 2 + two points 3 + 3) and 8 (Míniú) plus Gaeilge 5.

2017 prints no per-question band tables (2018–2020 do): each prose and poetry answer is its question, its “Eolas = N marc”, its Treoir and any printed split, ending at the marking-panel note “Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir …”. The scheme’s one grading table, “Grádú Marcála sna Freagraí” (PDF 30, the Sármhaith/An-mhaith/Maith/Measartha marks for each answer total from 200 to 5), is carried with the 5-mark Gaeilge note on every literature card’s Gaeilge criterion.

Q4A–E print no “Eolas = 35 marc” line of their own: the Ceist 4 Treoracha (“an t-eolas a mharcáil as 35 marc”) price them and are carried on each card. 4B prints “Dhá thréith luaite agus pléite…Blocmharcáil as 35 marc” and the deficient-answer box “Eolas (35-10) (25) =” for an answer that discusses only one trait; it is kept inside the answer as printed.
B 4(a) is priced {3 mharc} as one answer (the journey in the wheelchair 2 + its qualification), with printed partials 2 and 1: the part allows 0, 1, 2 and 3.

B 2(b)(i): the scheme prices the two things the United Nations says as {1 mharc + 1 mharc} and prints them in one accepted sentence (“… ag déanamh coireanna cogaidh agus ag sárú chearta an duine = 1 mharc + 1 mharc = 2 mharc”).
No legacy cards exist for 2017 Higher Paper 2: every card is new, with IDs in the 2018–2026 pattern.
